extracted.name: Gobhi 65😋
extracted.description: Let's enjoy totally restuarant style gobhi 65 with addition of manchurian masala mix. #madethis #heirloom
ingredient_lines: Half cup corn flour or arrawroot
Optional alternative for corn flour is gram flour
instruction_lines: First let prepare the gravy.roast in a pan after melting 2 tbsp of butter or oil roast cumin seeds+ginger+garlic and green chilli
Add diced onion and add all the spices and manchurian masala pouch to this.cook by adding little 1 cup water around until it thickened

For gobhi 65 mixture take all-purpose flour and corn flour with all mentioned ingredients and spices together with flours gently.add some water and mix well to make thick mixture but little flowing so it could coat on florets
Let's start coating the florets and deep fry them.fry 6 to 7 florets in once.deep fry at medium flame until looks golden.add all fried florets to gravy and mix gently.no need to cook
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.enjoy restaurant style gobhi 65.stay happy and healthy with annpurna_87
